paragraphs.en: Docling simplifies document processing by parsing diverse formats — including advanced PDF understanding — and providing seamless integrations with the generative AI ecosystem.
paragraphs.zh: Docling 通过解析多种格式（包括高级 PDF 理解能力）简化了文档处理，并与生成式 AI 生态系统实现无缝集成。

paragraphs.en: pip install docling Note: Python 3.9 support was dropped in docling version 2.70.0. Please use Python 3.10 or higher.
paragraphs.zh: pip install docling 注意：docling 2.70.0 版本已不再支持 Python 3.9。 请使用 Python 3.10 或更高版本。

sents.en: pip install docling Note: Python 3.9 support was dropped in docling version 2.70.0.
sents.zh: pip install docling 注意：docling 2.70.0 版本已不再支持 Python 3.9。
请使用 Python 3.10 或更高版本。

paragraphs.en: Works on macOS, Linux and Windows environments for both x86_64 and arm64 architectures.
paragraphs.zh: 适用于 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 环境，支持 x86_64 和 arm64 两种架构。

paragraphs.en: More detailed installation instructions are available in the docs.
paragraphs.zh: 更详细的安装说明可在文档中查阅。

paragraphs.en: docling https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.01062 This generates a .md file in the current directory containing structured document content.
paragraphs.zh: docling https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.01062 此命令会在当前目录下生成一个包含结构化文档内容的 .md 文件。

paragraphs.en: You can also use 🥚 GraniteDocling and other VLMs via Docling CLI:
paragraphs.zh: 您还可以通过 Docling CLI 使用 🥚 GraniteDocling 和其他视觉语言模型（VLM）：

paragraphs.en: docling --pipeline vlm --vlm-model granite_docling https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.01062 3. Python usage (recommended) from docling . document_converter import DocumentConverter source = "https://arxiv.org/pdf/2408.09869" # a document via a local path or URL converter = DocumentConverter () result = converter . convert ( source ) print ( result . document . export_to_markdown ()) # output: "## Docling Technical Report[...]" More advanced usage and configuration options.
paragraphs.zh: docling --pipeline vlm --vlm-model granite_docling https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.01062 3. Python 用法（推荐）from docling . document_converter import DocumentConverter source = "https://arxiv.org/pdf/2408.09869" # 通过本地路径或 URL 指定的文档 converter = DocumentConverter () result = converter . convert ( source ) print ( result . document . export_to_markdown ()) # 输出："## Docling Technical Report[...]" 更多高级用法和配置选项。

sents.en: Python usage (recommended) from docling . document_converter import DocumentConverter source = "https://arxiv.org/pdf/2408.09869" # a document via a local path or URL converter = DocumentConverter () result = converter . convert ( source ) print ( result . document . export_to_markdown ()) # output: "## Docling Technical Report[...]" More advanced usage and configuration options.
sents.zh: Python 用法（推荐）from docling . document_converter import DocumentConverter source = "https://arxiv.org/pdf/2408.09869" # 通过本地路径或 URL 指定的文档 converter = DocumentConverter () result = converter . convert ( source ) print ( result . document . export_to_markdown ()) # 输出："## Docling Technical Report[...]" 更多高级用法和配置选项。
